btn.from_file.tip: Import text from a .txt file. Text over 100 pages uses the Multiple volumes setting.
btn.from_clipboard.tip: Import text from the clipboard. Text over 100 pages uses the Multiple volumes setting.
btn.copy_out.tip: Copy the whole book to %s. Use ⚙ for specific pages.
btn.gear.tip: Page ranges, markers and the rest of the mod settings.
volume.apply.tip: Load the selected volume into the editor. Save this book and take a new one for the next volume.
settings.title: CopyPasteBooks — settings
settings.now.range.label: Pages:
settings.now.range.tip: For example: 1-13, 15, 17-37. Leave empty for the whole book.
settings.now.markers.label: Page break markers
settings.now.markers.tip: Add '=== Page N ===' markers. Pasting them back preserves the layout if the pages still fit.
settings.now.tofile.tip: Save the selected pages to a .txt file.
settings.now.toclip.tip: Copy the selected pages to the clipboard.
settings.now.nobook: Open settings from a book to copy pages.
settings.defaults.dest.label: Copy to
settings.defaults.dest.tip: Where books are copied. Also selects the source for /importbook without arguments.
settings.defaults.fmt.label: Formatting
settings.defaults.fmt.tip: How to copy colors and styles. 'Ask' shows a choice only for formatted books.
settings.defaults.folder.label: Save folder:
settings.defaults.folder.tip: Files are saved here when a path is set. Empty means showing the save dialog every time.
settings.defaults.folder.clear.tip: Clear the folder — go back to asking every time.
settings.defaults.bytelimit.label: Page byte limit:
settings.defaults.bytelimit.tip: Limit for From file, From clipboard and /importbook; it does not affect Ctrl+V. 0 = an automatic 2048 bytes.
settings.defaults.lang.label: Language
settings.defaults.lang.tip: The mod's interface language. Auto follows the game language.
ask.title: This book has formatting
ask.body: This book contains colored or styled text. Keep the formatting as § codes, or copy plain text only?
ask.with.tip: Colors and styles are written as § codes, e.g. §6gold§r. Pasting such text back into a book keeps the codes.
ask.plain.tip: All formatting is removed; only the visible text is copied.
msg.pasted.volume: Inserted volume %d of %d. Pages: %d. Sign it, take a new book and quill, then repeat the command.
err.no_book: Hold the book you want to copy (main or off hand)
err.need_writable: Hold a book and quill — text can only be pasted into a writable book
err.range.bad: Bad page range: '%s'. Expected something like: 1-13, 15, 17-37
err.range.out: The range is outside the book. Pages available: %d.
err.dialog.save: The save dialog didn't open. Choose a save folder in the settings.
err.text.empty: Nothing to paste: the text is empty
err.not_ingame: This command only works in a world
dialog.open.title: Paste into book — choose a text file
dialog.save.title: Save book as
msg.pasted.volume.last: Inserted the final volume %d of %d. Pages: %d. All volumes are ready.
settings.defaults.folder.browse.tip: Pick a folder. If the window doesn't open, type the path into the field.
dialog.folder.title: Folder to save books into
err.folder.dialog: The folder picker didn't open — type the path into the field instead.
err.dialog.busy: A file dialog is already open — it may be hidden behind the game window.
err.screen.closed: The book screen was closed while the dialog was open — nothing was pasted.
settings.defaults.method.label: Multiple volumes
settings.defaults.method.tip: Auto fills several books; Manual loads one volume at a time.
settings.defaults.autoname.label: Name volumes automatically
settings.defaults.autoname.tip: Auto only. On signs volumes with a name and number; off leaves drafts with colored numbers.
warn.auto.morespace: Handed out %d of %d — free up inventory slots and repeat.
warn.auto.moreblanks: Filled %d of %d — the rest didn't fit (not enough books).
err.auto.noblanks: In survival you need empty books & quills in your hotbar or off-hand — the mod can't create books.
prompt.volume.name: Name for the volumes
prompt.volume.name.max: max %d characters (a number is added per volume)
confirm.capacity.title: Text doesn't fit
confirm.capacity.body: Books needed: %d. Empty books and quills: %d. Fill them and stop? The rest won't fit.
btn.erase.tip: Erase all text in this book
erase.title: Erase the book's text?
erase.body: The whole text of this book will be erased. You can undo it with Ctrl+Z while the book remains open. What happens when you close it depends on your 'Close edited book' setting.
settings.defaults.erase.label: Confirm erasing a book
settings.defaults.erase.tip: Confirm with a delay, without a delay, or with no prompt. Ctrl+Z works while the book stays open.
settings.defaults.delay.creative.label: Creative, ms:
settings.defaults.delay.creative.tip: Pause between books in creative. Default: %d ms.
settings.defaults.delay.survival.label: Survival, ms:
settings.defaults.delay.survival.tip: Pause between books in survival. Too little may get you disconnected by the server. Default: %d ms.
cmd.delay.creative.name: creative
cmd.delay.survival.name: survival
err.busy.filling: Books are still being filled — wait until it finishes.
warn.slot.changed: A target slot was no longer free — that volume was skipped.
volume.reset.tip: End the current multi-volume import and hide its volume buttons.
settings.defaults.hidevol.label: Hide volume buttons when done
settings.defaults.hidevol.tip: Manual only. Hides the volume buttons after every volume has been inserted.
settings.defaults.smartpaste.label: Smart paste (Ctrl+V)
settings.defaults.smartpaste.tip: Pastes at the cursor and moves the rest onto following pages. Ctrl+Z undoes; Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes (Cmd on macOS).
settings.defaults.close.label: Close edited book
settings.defaults.close.tip: When an edited book closes with Escape or the inventory key: ask, save, or discard the changes.
close.title: Save changes to this book?
close.body: You changed this book without pressing Done. Choose whether to save the draft, close without saving, or keep editing.
close.settings.question: Does this window annoy you?
close.settings.answer: You can change it in the settings
warn.paste.trimmed: Not everything was pasted: a book holds at most 100 pages, the pasted tail was cut off (Ctrl+Z to undo)
err.paste.toobig: Paste cancelled: the result would exceed 100 pages and overwrite existing text
err.char.toobig: Cannot insert the character "%s": it takes %d bytes, but the page byte limit is %d
